diagnostics.message: aws_ecs_cluster_capacity_providers.this associates capacity providers with the cluster and configures default_capacity_provider_strategy entries built from local.cluster_capacity_providers, which merges in the autoscaling capacity providers from aws_ecs_capacity_provider.this. No dependency (implicit or explicit) is recorded between them, so Terraform may create the association before the capacity providers exist; ECS rejects a cluster capacity-provider update referencing providers that are not yet registered. Add a depends_on or, better, derive the autoscaling provider names directly from the resource so the ordering is inferred.

fix.expression:
distinct(concat(
  [for k, v in var.fargate_capacity_providers : try(v.name, k)],
  [for k, v in aws_ecs_capacity_provider.this : v.name]
))
